use_case_summary: Primary: embeddings-driven doc search (fast recall + semantic ranking) and an in-product chat assistant for troubleshooting. Secondary: lightweight personalization snippets generated at page load. High read volume for embeddings, bursty chat traffic during releases.
requirements_summary: Workloads: embeddings (high throughput), chat (low-latency p95 target), reranking for search
Latency targets: chat p95 < 120ms, embeddings batch latency < 500ms for 64-item batches
Throughput target: sustained 1,500 embedding reqs/min; peak chat concurrent ~200
Cost sensitivity: medium-high — needs unit economics forecast for 6/12/24 months
Model preferences: prefer quantized open models (7B) for baseline; allow fallback to 13B non-quantized for quality-sensitive routes

Routing/fallback needs: canary rollout (5% -> 25% -> 100%), automatic fallback to higher-capacity model variant on quality regression, region failover plan (us-east-1 -> eu-west-1) with sticky KV-cache invalidation policy
Security/compliance: VPC control plane, KMS-managed keys, SSO/SAML, audit logs retained 12 months, optional data residency in us-only
poc_plan: Duration: 2 weeks Dedicated POC (customer-owned VPC), 3 node GPU pool initially
Canary config: start 5% traffic to Dedicated, evaluate for 48h, then step to 25% if SLOs met
Metrics to monitor: p95 latency, tokens/sec, cost per 1k tokens, embedding recall@10, generation quality score on 100 test prompts
Fallback strategy: automated route to 13B variant if quality drop > 6% on eval set for 1h; region failover plan tested via controlled outage simulation
Rollback: immediate traffic drain to Hosted API fallback + alerting if Dedicated cluster error rate > 1% sustained 5 minutes
poc_acceptance_criteria: Chat p95 <= 120ms on 95% of samples under expected load
Embedding batch latency < 500ms for 64 vectors at 95th percentile
Cost analysis shows >=20% savings vs Hosted API plan for expected 12-month traffic profile OR clear path via Optimize recommendations
Quality parity: top-3 retrieval relevance delta <= 4% vs baseline model
Security checks: KMS integration validated, SSO/SAML test passed, audit logs captured in customer's SIEM
